description: Merge duplicate records. Keeps keep_id, folds each drop_ids record's relations (calls/emails/campaigns/meetings/memory/channels/…) into it, then DELETES the duplicates. Fields: primary wins, its empty fields are filled from the duplicate, and field_overrides forces final values for conflicts. entity = 'lead'|'contact'|'account'. IRREVERSIBLE.

drop_ids.description: duplicate record ids to merge in and delete

field_overrides.description: final values for specific columns on the kept record (wins over primary+gap-fill)

name: merge_records
